payment.overpaid: Paid money plus trade-in is more than the purchase total.

actions.notEnoughCash: The payment method's account does not have enough money. Add money in "Cash", or untick "Take the paid amount from the cash accounts" if this stock was paid earlier.
actions.receivedToast: The purchase was received and added to stock.
actions.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.
actions.receiveBody: RX codes will be created and the parts added to stock; the purchase cannot be edited afterwards.
actions.cancelBody: The draft will be cancelled and nothing will be added to stock.

received.title: {count, plural, one {One item was added to stock} other {# items were added to stock}}
received.photosHint: Add each item's photos from stock so it shows in the store.
received.addPartsHint: You can add parts from stock to the build from its page.

brands.englishName: Write the brand name in English.
brands.createFailed: The brand could not be added. Try again.

builds.title: Builds
builds.lockedNote: This build was sold or disassembled, so it can no longer be edited.

create.title: New build
create.name: Build name
create.firstPartHint: You can start it empty and type its parts inside the build, even if they are not in stock.

actions.unpublishDone: The build is no longer in the store
actions.disassembleDone: The build was disassembled and its parts are back in stock
actions.disassembleBody: Every part goes back to stock as available, and the build can no longer be edited.

card.title: Build details
card.name: Build name
card.warrantyHint: The build's warranty applies to every part, and any part can set its own.

parts.title: {count, plural, =0 {Parts} one {# part} other {# parts}}
parts.addNew: Add a new part (not in stock)
parts.hint: A partner percent in orange was changed for this part only. Remove asks whether the part goes back to stock or to another build.

addNew.title: Add a new part
addNew.hint: The part is recorded in stock with an RX code and joins the build right away.

replaceDialog.title: Replace {name}
replaceDialog.stockNote: The old part {code} goes back to stock as available.
replaceDialog.buildNote: The two parts swap places between the two builds.

split.title: Revenue split between parts
split.hint: The share of the sale price each part gets. It must add up to 100%.

planned.title: Typed parts (not in stock)
planned.hint: Type the build's parts even if you don't have them. Nothing is reserved; a model you have in stock is linked. Replace them with parts from stock before publishing.
planned.name: Part

basisHint.FinancedParts: This is the default for every part they finance, and it can be changed for one part.
basisHint.WholeShop: This is a share of the shop's whole net profit, posted at each month close.

parts.title: Parts they financed ({count})
parts.hint: Change the share of one part from the inventory (open the part by its code) or from the build page. Changed shares show in orange.

capital.title: Capital movements
capital.hint: A movement is recorded for good: it cannot be edited or deleted.

payouts.title: Profit payouts
payouts.hint: If the partner owes an amount (for example after a return), it is set off against the payout and shown in the Set off column.

monthClose.title: Month close
monthClose.hint: Works out the share of the partners paid from the whole shop's profit from the net result and posts it once for the month.
monthClose.confirmBody: The earnings are posted to the partners and cannot be changed afterwards.
monthClose.failed: The month was not closed. Try again.
monthClose.base: Base the shares are taken from
monthClose.nothingPosted: No earnings were posted to any partner.

changes.title: Change details
changes.restored: This change put earlier values back.
changes.pick: Pick a change from the list to see before and after.

security.title: Event details
security.notOnPage: This record is not on the current page.

restore.title: Restore the old values
restore.body: The record goes back to the values it had before this change. The restore is logged too.

fields.Label: Label
fields.Name: Name
fields.PaymentWaivedByUserAccountId: Payment waived by user account id
fields.Subject: Subject
fields.Title: Title

users.title: Users and roles
users.rolesHint: Pick a role to change its permissions, or create a new one.

invite.title: Add a user
invite.hint: They get an invitation email to sign in with, or can use a Google account with the same email. No passwords.

detail.emailNote: Signs in with this email (code or Google):

rolesCard.title: User roles
rolesCard.stepUpNote: Changing roles needs the confirmation code sent to your email.
rolesCard.emptyBody: The user will have no permissions and cannot work in the admin.

confirm.Suspension: The account is signed out and cannot sign in until the day you picked.
confirm.Ban: The account is signed out and cannot sign in until someone lifts the ban.
confirm.reinstate: The account can sign in again, and the reason is kept in the activity log.

roleEditor.name: Name
roleEditor.stepUpNote: Saving needs the confirmation code sent to your email.

permissions.systemWarning: This role gets system permissions (users, backups, data reset...). Make sure that is what you want.

Audit.Restore: Restore old values from the log

Catalog.ManageProducts: Add and edit items and builds

Sales.ApproveOrder: Confirm orders and move their status
Sales.OverrideMinimumPrice: Change prices beyond the discount limit

System.Purge: Delete from the trash for good

controls.title: Account controls
controls.disableBody: They are signed out and cannot sign in until you enable the account again.
controls.enableBody: They can sign in again with their email or Google.
controls.signOutBody: Every open device is signed out; they sign in again with an email code or Google.
controls.self: This is your account: you cannot disable it, change its roles or restrict it here.
controls.auditNote: Every action here is recorded in the activity log.
controls.failed: That did not work. Try again.
controls.conflict: Someone else changed this account. The page is updated; try again.

profile.title: User profile
profile.noCustomerRecord: No customer account shares this email or phone.
profile.linkRule: Linked because the email or phone is the same.
profile.noteHint: Only the admin team sees this.

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Anything deleted lands here first. Deleting forever needs its own permission.
trash.purgeBody: "{label}" will be deleted for good and cannot be restored. We will ask for a code sent to your email.

backups.title: Backups
backups.hint: A full copy with the data, images and settings. Run one now and check it is sound.
backups.downloadBody: The backup holds all the store's data. We will ask for a code sent to your email.

export.title: Export data
export.hint: Leave the dates empty to export the last 30 days.
export.badRange: The start date is after the end date.
export.stepUpNote: Exporting customers needs a code sent to your email.
export.audited: Every export is recorded in the audit log.

pdf.note: The print screen opens: pick “Save as PDF” to keep the file.
pdf.ready: The table is ready to print

reset.title: Reset data
reset.hint: Deletes the data you pick for good. A backup is taken automatically first.
reset.sections: Tick what you want to delete, then press Confirm.

business.title: Business
business.body: Orders, sales, stock, expenses and accounts.

reset.customersNeedBusiness: Deleting customers also deletes the business data, because orders and warranties point to them.
reset.stepUpNote: Owner only, and needs a code sent to their email.
reset.result: {rows} rows deleted. A backup was taken before it.
reset.typeBody: The items below will be deleted for good. A backup is taken first, then we will ask for a code sent to your email.

settings.title: Store settings
settings.conflict: Another user changed the settings. Reloading.

store.title: Store logo
store.removeBody: The site will use the name instead until you upload another one.
store.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 12 MB.

watermark.title: Watermark logo
watermark.removeBody: New photos will use the store logo instead.
watermark.hint: White on a transparent background works best. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 12 MB.

storeInfo.title: Store data
storeInfo.hint: Store name, domain, email, WhatsApp hours and pickup details.
storeInfo.name: Store name
storeInfo.pickupHint: The address and hours show on the pickup page, footer and invoice.

contactLinks.title: Contact links
contactLinks.hint: These links show in the footer, contact page, floating button and invoice.
contactLinks.numberHint: Mobile numbers are 8–15 digits, without + or spaces.

shipping.title: Shipping & pickup
shipping.hint: The fee and delivery time per governorate, and pickup from the store.
shipping.pickupHint: Its address and hours are in Store data.
shipping.restHint: Amounts are in EGP. Any governorate outside a group takes this fee and time.
shipping.governoratesHint: A governorate belongs to one group; the ones used in another group are locked.

payment.title: Payment & deposit
payment.hint: The deposit applies above a set amount, and shipping can be paid upfront.
payment.depositRequiredHint: When off, no order is asked for a deposit; you can also waive it for a single order from the order page.
payment.shippingUpfrontHint: Added to the upfront amount with the deposit.
payment.depositHint: Amounts are in EGP. Pickup from the store needs no deposit.
payment.methodsHint: At least one method must stay on.

controls.title: Store controls
controls.hint: Maintenance, the announcement bar and what the homepage shows.
controls.maintenanceHint: The site closes and shows customers a message.
controls.showSoldOut: Show sold-out items (with a notify button)
controls.showCountdown: Show the offer countdown on products
controls.guestCheckoutHint: Off means the customer must sign in before ordering.
controls.homepageHint: Move up and down to reorder, and tick what shows.

risk.title: Confirm the risky changes
risk.maintenance: The site closes to customers and shows them the maintenance message. Staff stay in.
risk.guest: Customers must create an account before ordering.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp messages
whatsapp.hint: The ready messages; each button opens WhatsApp with this text.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.minimumHint: Stars appear on a product only after this many reviews.

language.title: Language
language.hint: The default language and whether English is available.
language.englishHint: The EN button in the header.
language.note: Part names and specs stay as they are. The interface, categories, policies and product description (when written in English) are translated.

risk.title: Turn English off?
risk.body: The site becomes Arabic only and the EN button disappears.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.hint: The invoice number prefix and look.
invoice.termsHint: Optional; shows at the end of the invoice.

leadSources.title: Lead sources
leadSources.hint: The 'how did you hear about us?' choices on an order.

warranty.title: Warranty options
warranty.hint: The choices the warranty field in stock offers.
warranty.label: Warranty label
warranty.monthsHint: Leave months empty for the agent's warranty.

sales.title: Reservations & sales
sales.hint: How long stock is held and the POS discount limit.
sales.autoReleaseHint: Off means staff are notified instead of releasing it.
sales.reservationHint: Stock is held for this long after an order is confirmed.
sales.posHint: For staff without the price-override permission.

watermark.title: Watermark
watermark.hint: Applied automatically to item, build and article photos.
watermark.fallback: Without a watermark logo, the store logo is used.
watermark.oldImagesHint: The original is kept without the mark, so you can apply this setting to every old photo. Save the setting first if you changed it.
watermark.reapplyBody: Every item, build and article photo is reprocessed with the current watermark. It runs in the background and may take a while.

backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: The daily backup, its time and how many days are kept.
backup.hint2: The hour is 0–23. Archives older than the kept days are deleted.

risk.title: Turn the backup off?
risk.body: There will be no automatic daily backup.

stockImport.title: Import stock from Excel
stockImport.rowsChanged: Some rows have errors. Upload the file again.

fileProblems.type: The file must be an Excel .xlsx file.
fileProblems.size: The file is larger than 2 MB.

step1.title: 1. Download the template
step1.hint: Fill the template with your stock. The brand column is optional: write the name as it is on the brands page. Delete the example row before uploading.

step2.title: 2. Upload the file
step2.hint: Every row is checked first and nothing is saved.

summary.clean: {rows, plural, one {1 row is fine} other {# rows are fine}} — {items, plural, one {1 item} other {# items}} will be created.
summary.withErrors: {errorRows, plural, one {1 row has errors} other {# rows have errors}}. Fix them in the file and upload it again.

step3.title: 3. Import
step3.button: Import {count, plural, one {1 item} other {# items}}
step3.done: Imported {count, plural, one {1 item} other {# items}}.
step3.photosHint: Items only show in the store once you add 3 photos to each.

brands.title: Brands
brands.empty: Pick a brand from the list or create a new one.
brands.slugHint: Lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes. It appears in the brand filter link.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.pickHint: Pick a coupon from the list or create a new one.
coupons.deleteBody: The coupon will be deleted for good.
coupons.deleteUsed: This coupon has been used and cannot be deleted. Turn it off instead.
coupons.usedNote: This coupon has been used, so it cannot be deleted. You can turn it off.
coupons.hint: Dates are in Cairo time; a coupon starts at the beginning of its first day and ends at the end of its last day.
coupons.endBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the start date.
coupons.sourcePlaceholder: e.g. Ahmed – TikTok or Facebook ad November

errors.code: The code must be 3 to 30 letters, digits or dashes, and not used before.
errors.discountValue: A percent from 1 to 90, or an amount above zero.
errors.maxDiscount: A cap applies to a percent only and must be above zero.
errors.maxUses: Must be a whole number above zero.
errors.endsAtUtc: The end date must be after the start.

problems.NotFound: This coupon code does not exist.
problems.Inactive: This coupon code is not active.
problems.NotStarted: This coupon code has not started yet.
problems.BelowMinimum: The order is below the minimum for this coupon.
problems.UsedUp: This coupon code has reached its usage limit.
problems.AlreadyUsed: You have already used this coupon code.
problems.Other: This coupon code is not valid.
